status: read/design only; product and test writes frozen for user-priority PR integration
observed_baseline: e9f9c5d; must recheck current HEAD, git status, merged runner changes, and active suite processes before writing
current_gap: runOne captures exit/timedOut and only returns stdout/stderr tails. main emits progress and final JSON to stdout but creates no durable per-run result file or unique run identity. Shared reports/captures are not bound to this subprocess execution.
compatibility_contract: Keep --list, --suite, --only parsing and existing exit-code policy.
Keep existing [suite] start/result lines and final JSON ok/results keys.
Keep whole-process-tree termination and late-close timeout protection.
No live provider/broker calls in tests; inject child processes.
proposed_minimal_design: Create a unique app/captures/verify-suite/<timestamp-and-random-id> directory for each suite run; never overwrite a previous run.
Persist result.json at start, after each step, and at completion. In-progress state must not claim success.
Write each step's complete stdout/stderr to its own actual files as chunks arrive. Preserve bounded tails in JSON for existing consumers.
Record suite selection, run ID, start/end timestamps, elapsed time, Git commit and honest working-tree identity/availability, step exit code/timeout/spawn error, and log paths.

The source identity should distinguish dirty snapshots; Git commit alone must not silently imply the working copy is clean. Exact hashing approach remains an implementation choice to keep bounded after merge review.

Do not infer that existing shared captures/reports belong to the run from their presence or mtime. Without a producer run-ID contract, explicitly mark their ownership unverified. Own result/log files are verifiably scoped by their unique run directory.
Handle child spawn throw/error as a failed persisted step, retaining any earlier completed steps and logs; preserve timeout cleanup behavior.
planned_red_green_tests: Success writes real run result, timestamps, source identity, complete stdout/stderr files and existing tails.
Nonzero exit is persisted as failed; no success upgrade from stale report/capture files.
Timeout retains actual output and timedOut=true after late close(0).
Spawn throw/error produces failed evidence and does not lose completed prior steps.
Two sequential runs have different directories/results and preserve the first run bytes.
An existing shared successful report/capture remains unverified and is neither overwritten nor treated as proof by the runner.
In-progress result is written before a deferred child completes.
Existing CLI/list and runner/catalog regression tests remain green.
